package demo;
public class Poller extends BComponent {
  public void started() { post(tick, null, null); }
  public void doTick() { post(tick, null, null); }
  private void kick() { post(tick, null, null); }
  public void changed(Property p, Context cx) { post(tick, null, cx); }
  public Runnable timer() {
    return new Runnable() { public void run() { post(tick, null, null); } };
  }
  public IFuture post(Action action, BValue argument, Context cx) { return super.post(action, argument, cx); }
}
